param: Ψ Total constant recruitment into susceptible classes (per time). Split by θ and γ.
θ Proportion of recruits who are men.
γ Proportion of male recruits who are heterosexual men (as used in recruitment split Ψθγ vs Ψθ(1-γ)).
μ Natural mortality rate (applies to all compartments).
α Departure rate from untreated infected compartments (I_h, I_w, I_m); split into treatment vs AIDS by p and (1-p).
p Proportion of departing untreated infected individuals who initiate ART (move to T).
δ Progression/treatment-failure rate from treatment T to AIDS A.
d AIDS-induced mortality rate (additional to μ) in AIDS compartment A.
λ_h Force of infection on susceptible homosexual men S_h (composed of homosexual contact; see Figure 1/2).
λ_w Force of infection on susceptible heterosexual men S_m due to contact with infected women (heterosexual transmission component).
λ_m Force of infection on susceptible women S_w due to contact with infected heterosexual men (heterosexual transmission component).
λ_hw Force of infection on susceptible women S_w due to contact with infected homosexual men (bisexual contact component: homosexual men → women).
λ_hm Force of infection on susceptible heterosexual men S_m due to contact with infected homosexual men (bisexual contact component: homosexual men → heterosexual men).
R₀ Basic reproduction number (overall), reported as max{R₀_hom, R₀_het}.
R₀_hom Basic reproduction number for homosexual transmission (reported formula in paper).
R₀_het Basic reproduction number for heterosexual transmission (reported formula in paper).
b_h Probability of contagion per homosexual contact (mentioned as b_h in text around infection forces).
b_s Probability of contagion per heterosexual contact (mentioned as b_s in R₀_het expression extract).
c_h Rate/number of sexual partners in exclusive homosexual contact (mentioned in scenarios and R₀_hom expression extract).
c_s Rate/number of sexual partners in exclusive heterosexual contact (mentioned in scenarios and R₀_het expression extract).
c_hw Rate/number of sexual partners in bisexual contact homosexual men → women (mentioned in Scenario 3 text).
c_hm Rate/number of sexual partners in bisexual contact homosexual men → heterosexual men (mentioned in Scenario 3 text).
